`modcheck validate` today binds only on --owner-said, so delegated new bars need MODCHECK_VALIDATE_BUILD_DELEGATED_NEW_BARS first; any edit to a validated section that removes or relaxes a line stays his.

reading.accept: A known-drain case reads correctly (capacity derived from bed levels x volumePerTile, channel fills asserted).
reading.defect: fw_pond_outflow_regression.py hardcodes CAP=30, but capacity is bed levels x volumePerTile (shallow = 2 notches), so `drained` is inflated and an undrained pond can pass; channel fills are never asserted.
reading.proposed_fix: Derive capacity from bed levels x volumePerTile instead of CAP=30 and assert the channel fills.

traps.text: The regression can pass with no drainage: six shallow cells hold 12 notch units, not 30, so an untouched pond reports drained=18, above the 6.5 threshold; if the inlet remains a source every scored condition passes.

reading.accept: Running P5 twice on one map gives the same depth.
reading.defect: depth_rebuild_proofs prepare_site repaints terrain but does not reset excavation; dig() adds deepenLevels to the existing cut, so a second --only p5 run on the same map measures deeper geometry and can falsely fail the 152,000 L expectation.
reading.proposed_fix: Reset excavation on the P5 site before dig() (as climb_proof.py does, which resets and checks its old digs).

traps.text: The default CLI permits rerunning --only p5 on the same map, which silently deepens the previous test geometry; a failure on the second run may be a false fail.

reading.proposed_fix: Make the Send path charge negative carry (as Take does with Mathf.Max(0,carry)).
